**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

The Agreement affirmatively achieves the preferred position on minimum commitments:

- **§ 2.1 (p0013)** — express disclaimer: "No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies," fees are for ordered Services only, and declining to place a further Order Form "is not a breach or shortfall."
- **§ 7.1 (p0026)** — bars Vendor from imposing any unstated "minimum-use, or similar charge."
- **§ 12 (p0051)** — acknowledges Customer has made no "minimum-volume" commitment.
- **§ 8.2 (p0035)** — renewals are twelve-month and exitable on 30 days' notice by Customer, with no quantity floor or no-downgrade language; § 13 imposes no volume caps on Customer usage.

No take-or-pay, shortfall penalty, or non-reducible seat count exists anywhere in the document, so there is nothing to narrow to the fallback.

One item flagged in the rationale but deliberately **not** redlined here to avoid double-counting a commercial term: § 7.7 (p0032) imposes late-payment "liquidated damages" of fifteen percent of annual Fees per week. That is a payment-terms/penalty issue rather than a purchase commitment, and belongs to the applicable payment or liquidated-damages rule.
